name: Soul Search
label: Revelation
lede: Soul Search put out a cassette, then 7"s on Thick Skin, Triple-B, Back To Back and Closed Casket Activities. In 2014 Revelation pressed one of them again as Rev155.

eras.title: A cassette, then small labels
eras.text: Soul Search came up in the California hardcore scene of the early 2010s the old way. First a cassette, then 7"s pressed by whichever small label would take the next one.

years.h: Soul Search cut Intolerable Weight at Earth Capital in Los Angeles
years.p: Five songs, including Depth and Wretch, recorded in May 2010. The first copies go out on cassette.
years.xp: The cassette was passed around through several small labels before anyone pressed it to vinyl. A year later it became a 7".

years.h: Thick Skin Records starts its catalog with the Intolerable Weight 7"
years.p: The cassette gets its vinyl release as Thick Skin Records TS-001.

years.h: Bury the Blame runs four songs in under nine minutes
years.p: Taylor Young engineered it for Triple-B Records. The label pressed it three times, the last in 2021.
years.xp: Discogs lists three pressings of the 7" on Triple-B, with the most recent from 2021, ten years after the record first came out.

years.h: Full set filmed by hate5six, August 12, 2012
yt: Full set filmed by hate5six, August 12, 2012

eras.title: Three guitarists, then Revelation
eras.text: By 2013 Soul Search had three guitar players. Nothing But a Nightmare came out on Back To Back Records, and a year later Revelation pressed it again.

years.cap: Soul Search playing to a packed floor, April 2014
years.h: Three guitarists back Nothing But a Nightmare on Back To Back
years.p: Aaron Chavez, Nick Evans and Ricky Duarte play guitar over Alfredo Gutierrez's bass and Dorian Zambrano's drums. Mattias Frisk draws the cover.
years.xp: Five songs. The cover art is by Mattias Frisk, and the record is the one Revelation took on the following year.

years.src: Discogs: Nothing But a Nightmare (Rev155) · Discogs: Nothing But a Nightmare (master)
yt: Nothing But a Nightmare, full EP
years.h: Revelation presses Nothing But a Nightmare again as Rev155
years.p: The run is 1,100 copies on dark grey vinyl and 550 on light grey.
years.xp: Revelation's catalog number for the reissue is Rev155. The original Back To Back release is listed separately on Discogs under the master release.

years.h: Omar Gonzalez sings two songs on a split with Minus
years.p: Damned To Be and Price of Freedom land on the Closed Casket Activities 7" on July 24.
years.xp: Closed Casket pressed 800 copies on red, 500 clear and 200 clear with red splatter.
